apparatus.basis: Single-character restoration. With ⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲩ (3pl object suffix) yields ⲟⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲩ 'they bring them' (Lyc. for ⲉⲓⲛⲉ; cf. glossary entry ⲟⲛ̄ⲧ⸗). Habitual sense fits the iterative description.
Relative marker ⲉⲧ- restored from context — the relative ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲛⲏⲩ later in the line confirms the antecedent.
Restoration of ⲍ to give ⲍⲛ̄ 'in' (Lyc. for ϩⲛ̄); standard locative preposition introducing 'their living icon.'
Standard Manichaean idiom ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ ⲁ- 'upward to'; only ⲏⲓ̈ ⲁ is restored, completing the directional phrase.
Single letter ⲅ restored to complete ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲅⲅⲥⲙⲟⲥ (= Greek μετάγγισμός 'decanting/transmigration') begun on previous line.
Restoration of ⲁ to complete ⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ 'disciples' across the line break.
Standard restoration of the ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth' directional formant.
Restoration of directional ⲁ- 'to' before ⲧⲡⲉ 'the heaven' on next line.
Standard Manichaean title ⲧⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲙ̄ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'the Virgin of Light' confirmed in glossary.
Restoration of ⲉ to complete the relative ⲉⲧⲉ continuing onto next line.
Restoration completes ⲛⲓⲱⲣⲍ 'the gazing' (cf. ⲣⲉϩⲓ̈ⲱⲣⲍ 'watcher' in glossary) and the relative ⲉⲧ- introducing the next clause.
Restoration of ⲧ to give ⲧⲉϩϣⲃⲓⲱ 'his recompense' (cf. ⲧⲱⲃⲓⲱ in glossary).

notes.decision: Translated 'stand fast' — variant of the standard idiom ⲧⲏⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧ⸗ (in glossary) using ⲱⲍⲉ (Lyc. for ⲱϩⲉ 'stand') with the directional ⲁⲣⲉⲧ⸗ 'on the feet of.' Same semantic field of upright establishment.
Translated 'the New Man' — Lyc. variant of ⲡⲣⲙ̄ⲛ̄ⲃⲣ̄ⲡⲉ (in glossary as the Pauline καινὸς ἄνθρωπος). The vowel-form ⲃϥ̄ⲣⲉ for ⲃⲣ̄ⲡⲉ shows the same root ⲃⲣ̄ⲣⲉ 'new' confirmed in vocabulary.

Translated ⲥⲁⲡ here as 'time/season' (per glossary 'time, appointed turn'), not as the homonym 'sword' attested in K.81. Context (the moment when the elect reach their first rest) demands the temporal sense.

Translated 'transmigration' — Greek loanword μετάγγισμός 'decanting, transfusion,' the standard technical term in Manichaean texts for the transmigration of sinful souls from body to body, paralleling ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲗⲗⲁⲥⲙⲟⲥ 'exchange/transmutation' in glossary.

Translated tentatively as 'a sentencing' — the form with double overlines suggests an abbreviated Greek-derived term, possibly a contracted 'judgment' or 'fixed-decree.' Could alternatively be ⲟⲩⲇⲩⲛⲁⲙⲓⲥ 'a power' or ⲟⲩⲧⲛⲟ 'a manner.' The pairing 'transmigration with X' fits Manichaean eschatology of judgment-driven metempsychosis.

The isolated ϩⲉ on lines 13 and 15 (along with em-dashes on line 14) appear to be decorative borders framing the chapter heading — a common feature of Manichaean codex layout. Translated as em-dashes to preserve the framing function.
Standard Coptic discourse-introducer 'once again' (cf. ⲧⲧⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲁⲛ in glossary). Opens the new chapter's narrative frame.
Translated 'the heaven' — Lyc. variant attested in glossary as ⲡⲓⲡⲉ 'the heaven (variant)' for ⲧⲡⲉ. Confirmed by parallel ⲧⲡⲉ in line 26.

Translated 'he lifted his eyes upward' — standard biblical idiom (Sah. ⲁϥϥⲓ ⲛ̄ⲛⲉϥⲃⲁⲗ ⲉϩⲣⲁⲓ). The Lyc. ⲁϩⲛ likely shows assimilation of ⲁϥ-ϥⲓ-ⲛ̄ 'he-lifted-of'; ⲛⲉϩⲃⲉⲗ = 'his eyes' (Lyc. plural with possessive prefix ⲛⲉϩ-).

Re-analyzed against the tentative glossary reading 'is paired-with.' Here parsed as conjunctive ⲧⲁ- (1sg) + ⲧⲥⲉⲃⲟ ('teach,' verbal form of ⲥⲃⲱ 'teaching,' per terminology guide) + ⲑⲏⲛⲉ (2pl object suffix) = 'and I shall teach you (pl.).' The narrative context — Mani about to expound the cloud-mystery — strongly favors this reading. ⲥⲃⲟ as 'teach' is firmly established.

Translated 'break her forth / spread her forth' — uses ⲃⲁϣ 'scatter / break apart' (in glossary, tentative) with 3sg.f object suffix -ⲥ̄ referring back to ⲧⲕⲗⲟⲟⲗⲉ 'the cloud.' Captures the cosmic agents' act of dispatching the cloud.

Translated 'over against the likeness' — ⲟⲩⲃⲉ ('against, opposite, before,' standard Coptic) + ⲡⲓⲛⲉ ('likeness,' per terminology guide). Captures the spatial-correspondential register: the rising cloud stands as the visible counterpart against the heavenly likeness of the Virgin of Light.

Translated 'the sign' — likely ⲡ + ⲥⲙⲉⲓⲛⲉ where ⲥⲙⲉⲓⲛⲉ = ⲙⲉⲓⲛⲉ 'sign, token' with prosthetic ⲥ-, or alternatively the verbal noun of ⲥⲙⲓⲛⲉ 'establish' substantivized. Either way, the cloud is identified as the visible sign of the Virgin of Light's gaze.
